cause.guard_change: The experimental patch admitted macro widths divisible by eight.
cause.unmodified_fixed_shape: PersistentRoutedPreparation::evaluate_exact_core8 still requires token_begin == 0 and hidden.size() == n_embd * 8.
cause.observed_effect: The width-16 hidden vector reaches the first fixed-width Core8 call and fails its shape check before executing layer 0.
cause.interpretation: This is a harness/architecture NO-GO, not evidence about the performance of two correctly composed Core8 transactions.

decision: Do not tune or repair V16 on this discovery fixture. A future V16 attempt requires a separately preregistered two-Core8 composition with recurrent-state chaining, checkpoint slicing, exact state/logit closure, and the same timing gate. Continue with the already-earned incremental B16-to-B20 hydration and held-out one-pass risk discriminator.
